name: Kameizumi Shuzo
about: Kameizumi Shuzo was founded in 1897 in Tosa, Kochi, when eleven people set up a sake shop to brew the sake they drank themselves. The name, meaning turtle spring, comes from the spring that supplies its brewing water.

The brewery is known mainly for sake made with CEL-24, a yeast developed by Kochi's Industrial Technology Center in 1993. It has used the yeast since its release in 1998, and its CEL-24 junmai ginjo came to make up about 70 percent of its output.
